151:163.en: 「If you don't resist,\nI'll look like the villain.」

151:249.en: 「Let's go all out, both of us.」

151:364.en: 「Your beloved Miss $$スズネ$$\nwill be taking you on.」

151:417.en: 「Too bad. I'm not the sweet, sweet\nMiss $$スズネ$$.」

151:480.en: 「As I thought, it feels better\nwithout the glasses.」

151:556.en: 「It feels good, moving my body\nby my own will.」

151:607.en: 「I know how you fight inside out.」

151:673.en: 「What a weirdo.\nDo you want me to hit you so badly?」

151:769.en: 「I can't stand them. The ones who\nclearly live out in the sun.」

151:826.en: 「Wreck your prized $$トライダー$$ and\nthe company goes under, $$ワッ太$$.」

151:981.en: 「Aren't you getting cocky,\nthinking you can't die?」

151:1159.en: 「Rough life, being a $$ニュータイプ$$.」

151:1200.en: 「Don't you get lonely, $$イノベイター$$?」

151:1235.en: 「$$コーディネイター$$...\nSo you're a born soldier.」

151:1292.en: 「Go see a future of despair with\nyour proud $$ゼロシステム$$.」

151:1470.en: 「Let's see what the ladies' man from\nacross space-time can do.」

151:1599.en: 「I doubt you can handle women,\n$$アルト$$.」

151:1652.en: 「Atami's shadow boss is a hero?\nYou crack me up, $$甲児$$.」

151:1860.en: 「With the tactics you hate so much,\nI'll flip your strategy over.」

151:2069.en: 「You're 12,000 years too early to\ndate, the lot of you.」

151:2192.en: 「Understand that you can't stay\na child forever.」

151:2440.en: 「You belong back with the fleet,\ncatching fish.」

151:2499.en: 「If the real Reactor loses to a\nnovice, that's a laughingstock.」

151:2554.en: 「Let's see how it's done,\nusing a $$スフィア$$.」

151:2613.en: 「When I take you down,\n$$バルビエル$$'s face will be a sight.」

151:2664.en: 「Sorry, $$エルーナルーナ$$.\nI'm taking this one.」

151:2715.en: 「Being liked by $$尸空#pilot$$,\nyou're out of luck.」

151:2768.en: 「Hand over $$ジェニオン$$\nand the $$スフィア$$.」

151:2860.en: 「Too bad. I'm not your beloved\nMiss $$スズネ$$.」

151:2917.en: 「I'll send you after your family.\nThat's my parting offering.」

151:3027.en: 「$$ジェミニオン・レイ$$...\nI'll make it mine.」

151:3203.en: 「Too bad I'm no longer the woman\nyou lot like.」

151:3395.en: 「Its power lives up to the flash.」

151:3625.en: 「Let's cut even the ties between us!」

151:3743.en: 「With the artificial $$スフィア$$,\nhow far can I go...」

151:3945.en: 「I won't let anyone get in the way!」

151:4326.en: 「$$スズネ$$ and I are polite women.」

151:4540.en: 「Move aside. I'll take it from here.」

151:4923.en: 「I knew.\nThis kind of trick is your forte.」

151:4974.en: 「Can't counter, so I'll let it go.」

151:5094.en: 「Heh...\n$$スズネ$$ was well loved, it seems.」

151:5143.en: 「Too slow. Your moves and your mind.」

151:5339.en: 「All you did was land a hit.」

151:5364.en: 「Don't hold back. Really come at me.」

151:5674.en: 「Hate the thought of hurting\nyour dear $$スズネ$$ that much?」

151:5723.en: 「How kind they are, the members\nof the Volunteer Club.」

151:6184.en: 「I won't let you take\nthe freedom I finally won...!」

151:6270.en: 「That's right...!\nThat's just the kind of guy you are!」

151:6405.en: 「Are you different from the one\nI know...!?」

151:6456.en: 「Three days apart and you've grown\n...is that how it goes...!」

151:6507.en: 「Geminid pride, my foot...!\nYou're late, $$ジェミニア#robot$$!」

151:6609.en: 「Stay out of this, $$スズネ$$!\nThis body is mine!」

151:6666.en: 「The artificial $$スフィア$$'s regeneration\ncan't keep up...!?」

151:6785.en: 「Tch! That man's sun is blinding me!」

151:6879.en: 「Even from afar, I can feel\n$$正太郎$$'s fighting spirit...!」

151:7018.en: 「You haven't piloted\na Gundam for nothing, huh...!」

151:7067.en: 「So this is the pressure of a Gundam!」

151:7155.en: 「I won't let a beast eat me...!」

151:7225.en: 「A song warps the artificial $$スフィア$$!?」

151:7305.en: 「Shadow boss indeed, $$兜甲児$$...!\nYou show no mercy!」

151:7356.en: 「You're livelier than you ever look\nat school, just as I thought!」

151:7411.en: 「This guy... not just 24 hours,\nhe could work all year round!」

151:7470.en: 「As I thought, you're more bouncer\nthan Negotiator!」

151:7529.en: 「You can read my every move, $$ゼロ$$!」

151:7605.en: 「So this is your love for $$かなめ$$!」

151:7765.en: 「Tch!\nI can't let that fire swallow me!」

151:7923.en: 「As always, you snap in\nmagnificent style, $$シンジ$$!」

151:8109.en: 「Their Reactor level is about equal\nto the Empire's lot!」

151:8164.en: 「Damn...! I'm the one who's sad here!」

151:8244.en: 「So he's more than just a man\nwho's fussy about money...!」

151:8293.en: 「You hit your dear Miss $$スズネ$$, huh!」

151:8332.en: 「I took you for a poor student,\nbut you're really something...!」

151:8387.en: 「You've gotten pretty good\nat using the $$スフィア$$, haven't you!」

151:8448.en: 「I should know all of its\npiloting quirks, and yet...!」

151:8509.en: 「This guy...!\nComing at me to get $$スズネ$$ back!」

151:8621.en: 「You don't show a shred\nof volunteer spirit!」

151:8670.en: 「You lot lack the spirit of service!」

151:8711.en: 「Tch...!\nFired up to save $$スズネ$$, are you...!」

151:8811.en: 「I'll save the fun for next time...」

151:8893.en: 「Tch! Why can't I beat those guys!?」

151:8934.en: 「Ha ha ha ha ha!\nDoing this is pointless!」

151:9026.en: 「Show drive enough for a no-reset, non-stop clear.」

151:9131.en: 「Heh... I expect a lot. Hurry back.」

151:9256.en: 「Pausing? Perfect. Let the player pick, me or you.」

151:9339.en: 「Pick me for service no stiff teacher offers.」
